requiredCopy: AI agents that work like a real team
Agents propose, debate, and ship together while a human sets the goal, approves at gates, and judges the result.
像真正团队一样协作的 AI 智能体
智能体共同提出方案、展开辩论并完成交付；人类设定目标、在关键节点审批，并评判最终结果。

runtimeFeatures.title: Collaboration rounds
runtimeFeatures.description: Agents develop independent proposals, critique one another, and synthesize a stronger shared direction.

runtimeFeatures.title: Structured decisions
runtimeFeatures.description: The control plane validates structured decisions before work moves forward.

runtimeFeatures.title: Durable team state
runtimeFeatures.description: PostgreSQL stores durable state while NATS carries messages between collaborating agents.

runtimeFeatures.title: Gates and mid-run steering
runtimeFeatures.description: Use the dashboard to approve gates or steer the team while a run is in progress.

runtimeFeatures.title: Live per-agent token accounting
runtimeFeatures.description: Session Totals show live token accounting for each agent.

runtimeFeatures.title: Provider-neutral adapters
runtimeFeatures.description: Use Codex today, with a deterministic mock for demos and CI.

verifiedFacts.claim: AgentWeave is an open-source runtime where multiple AI agents collaborate like a real team.
verifiedFacts.pageText: AgentWeave is the open-source runtime where multiple AI agents collaborate like a real team.

verifiedFacts.claim: The runtime uses PostgreSQL for durable state and NATS for messaging.
verifiedFacts.pageText: PostgreSQL stores durable state while NATS carries messages between collaborating agents.
